name: Four Seasons Resort Lanai
positioning: Oceanfront resort on the southeastern coast of Lanai, overlooking Hulopo'e Bay, with an on-site golf course
best_for: Golfers who want an on-site course designed by Jack Nicklaus
Families who want a complimentary kids' program
Travelers who want a secluded island stay with Japanese and Italian dining on site

facts.text: The resort is on the southeastern coast of the island of Lanai.
The resort overlooks the protected marine preserve of Hulopo'e Bay.
Manele Golf Course, designed by Jack Nicklaus, is on site.
Osteria Mozza Lanai serves Italian cuisine.
Malibu Farm is a poolside restaurant perched above Hulopoe Bay.
The resort's spa is called Hawanawana Spa.
The Fitness Centre is open 24 hours.
The Kids For All Seasons program is complimentary.
The resort charges no resort fee.

highlights.text: NOBU LANAI offers innovative Japanese cuisine from Chef Nobu Matsuhisa.
More than 75 percent of food and beverage ingredients are sourced from local farmers, fisheries and purveyors.
The resort has an adults-only pool.
The 12th hole at Manele Golf Course tees off from a cliff 150 feet (45 metres) above the ocean.
Lanai Air round-trip flights from Honolulu are included in all room bookings with arrivals by December 31, 2027.

considerations.text: From Maui, guests can travel to Lanai by ferry or commercial air.
Only 30 miles (48 kilometres) of Lanai's roads are paved.
Lanai Air flights between Honolulu and Lanai operate between 7:00 am and 6:00 pm.
WhataHotel notes the remote island location requires additional travel planning.

perks.text: With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, breakfast for two is free daily.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get a priority upgrade if available at check-in.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get a $100 hotel credit.
WhataHotel special offers can be combined with the exclusive perks.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get free Wi-Fi access.
